      "statement": "The bidder offers to provide the service described in the tender documents at the prices in the price schedule, on the terms of the contract.",

    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0247"],
      "quote": "We confirm that none of the exclusion grounds in Annex E applies to us or to any subcontractor we name.",
      "statement": "The bidder confirms that none of the exclusion grounds in Annex E applies to the bidder or to any subcontractor named.",

      "hazard": true
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0248"],
      "quote": "We confirm that we have read every addendum published on the portal before the tender deadline.",
      "statement": "The bidder confirms that it has read every addendum published on the portal before the tender deadline.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": true
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0249"],
      "quote": "Signed by a director of the bidder: name, position, date.",
      "statement": "The tender is signed by a director of the bidder, including name, position, and date.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": true
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0250"],
      "quote": "The Council excludes a bidder from the procedure if any of the grounds below applies to the bidder, to any of its directors or to any subcontractor it names.",
      "statement": "The Council excludes a bidder from the procedure if any of the exclusion grounds applies; this binds the Council.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "NOT_BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0251"],
      "quote": "A conviction in the last five years for fraud, bribery, money laundering, terrorist offenses or the use of forced labor.",
      "statement": "A conviction in the last five years for fraud, bribery, money laundering, terrorist offenses, or forced labor is an exclusion ground.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "NOT_BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0252"],
      "quote": "A failure to pay taxes or social security contributions that a court or an authority has confirmed.",
      "statement": "A confirmed failure to pay taxes or social security contributions is an exclusion ground.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "NOT_BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0253"],
      "quote": "Insolvency, bankruptcy or an arrangement with creditors.",
      "statement": "Insolvency, bankruptcy, or an arrangement with creditors is an exclusion ground.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "NOT_BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0254"],
      "quote": "Serious misconduct, or the early termination of a public contract in the last three years for poor performance.",
      "statement": "Serious misconduct or early contract termination in the last three years is an exclusion ground.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "NOT_BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0262"],
      "quote": "The Contractor shall respond to a Priority 1 incident within 15 minutes, in place of the 30 minutes in the table in section 9.",
      "statement": "The Contractor responds to a Priority 1 incident within 15 minutes, in place of the 30 minutes in the table in section 9.",
      "modality": "shall",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0264"],
      "quote": "Bidders must confirm in the Form of Tender that they have read this addendum.",
      "statement": "Bidders must confirm in the Form of Tender that they have read this addendum.",
      "modality": "must",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": true
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0266"],
      "quote": "The Council will provide an anonymized copy of the Quillbeck data for each trial migration.",
      "statement": "The Council provides an anonymized copy of the Quillbeck data for each trial migration; this binds the Council, not the supplier.",
      "modality": "will",
      "disposition": "OUT_OF_SCOPE",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0270"],
      "quote": "B-01 | The Contractor shall keep every audit record for five (5) years after the case closes. | Mandatory",
      "statement": "The Contractor keeps every audit record for five years after the case closes.",
      "modality": "shall",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": true
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0271"],
      "quote": "B-02 | The service shall send an acknowledgment with a case reference to the resident within one working day of each new case. | Mandatory",
      "statement": "The service sends an acknowledgment with a case reference to the resident within one working day of each new case.",
      "modality": "shall",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": true
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0272"],
      "quote": "B-03 | The Contractor shall flow down every data protection and security obligation in this annex to its subcontractors. | Mandatory",
      "statement": "The Contractor flows down every data protection and security obligation in this annex to its subcontractors.",
      "modality": "shall",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": true
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0273"],
      "quote": "B-04 | The service shall offer each resident a short satisfaction survey when a case closes. | Desirable",
      "statement": "The service offers each resident a short satisfaction survey when a case closes.",
      "modality": "shall",
      "disposition": "OPTIONAL",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0274"],
      "quote": "B-05 | The service should suggest likely duplicate cases to staff when a new case is opened. | Desirable",
      "statement": "The service should suggest likely duplicate cases to staff when a new case is opened.",
      "modality": "should",
      "disposition": "OPTIONAL",
      "hazard": false
    }
